usedFor: Shopify abandoned checkouts become AnyDB rows you can follow up on.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Record” in AnyDB
bestTemplate.why: An abandoned checkout carries the shopper's email or phone, so each becomes a follow-up row.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” polls, so AnyDB rows appear a little after the shopper leaves.
